2610.09994.title: Temporal Predictive Multiplicity: Equally Accurate Time Series Models Yield Different Forecast Trajectories
2610.09994.paper_summary: Models with near-identical predictive performance can yield substantially different predictions, a phenomenon known as predictive multiplicity. Prior work has mostly studied this at the level of individual scalar outputs. In time-series forecasting, however, predictions across horizons jointly define a trajectory, and horizon-wise comparisons can hide important differences in predictive behavior. To address this problem, we introduce temporal predictive multiplicity, a framework that characterizes disagreement over complete forecast trajectories among models with near-identical predictive performance. We show that constraining predictive performance alone can still admit a broad range of different trajectories. We further show that constraining multiplicity at individual horizons partially reduces, but does not eliminate, trajectory-level multiplicity. Experiments with 19 neural forecasting architectures on 11 datasets confirm that near-optimal models can exhibit substantial variability in the forecast trajectories they produce, and trajectory-level disagreement is largely unrelated to horizon-wise disagreement. Our framework, therefore, exposes a gap in existing multiplicity studies: models with indistinguishable predictive performance imply fundamentally different temporal trajectories, with consequential downstream effects.
2610.09994.paper_summary_zh: 具有近乎相同預測性能的模型可能會產生截然不同的預測，這一現象被稱為預測多重性。先前的研究主要集中在單一標量輸出的層面上。然而，在時間序列預測中，不同時間範圍的預測共同定義了一條軌跡，而按時間範圍進行的比較可能會掩蓋預測行為中的重要差異。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了時間預測多重性，這是一個描述在具有近乎相同預測性能的模型之間對完整預測軌跡的不一致的框架。我們顯示，僅僅限制預測性能仍然可以容許廣泛的不同軌跡。我們進一步顯示，在單個時間範圍內限制多重性部分減少，但並不消除軌跡層面的多重性。對11個數據集上19個神經預測架構的實驗確認，近乎最佳的模型在其產生的預測軌跡中可以表現出顯著的變異性，並且軌跡層面的不一致與時間範圍層面的不一致在很大程度上無關。因此，我們的框架揭示了現有多重性研究中的一個空白：具有無法區分的預測性能的模型暗示著根本不同的時間軌跡，並產生重要的下游影響。
